integrity: General statements supported by symbolic cell-pattern proof; finite exact independent checker is supplementary and not a proof of unbounded claims. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: A quantitative finite tuple-orbit result with credited pre-existing automorphism theorem and general counting machinery. Priority not externally certified. The complete earlier Jones manuscript was unavailable; possible older higher-order Johnson-scheme enumeration remains a risk. Fixed-arity asymptotics concern orbit types, not uniformly random labelled tuples. Independent audit not performed.
title: Ternary symmetry defect and complete tuple-orbit profiles of balanced Johnson graphs
